packaging: Re-signable IPA with original app identifier and app-group entitlement. The installer must re-sign the package, including updated metadata and the injected module.
validation: The identical private R10 module completed six unlocks and six locks on a stock iPhone 12 Pro Max; three of each occurred in a recorded locked/background interval. Earlier R8 worked on the jailbroken iPhone X. The XS runs the app but has unresolved inconsistent proximity readings, including a reported indoor unlock. Public R3 AltStore update has not yet been exercised.
known_issue: Inconsistent RSSI on one iPhone XS persists after iOS 18.7.10; an unintended indoor unlock was reported during earlier testing. Hardware cause is not established. Disable walk-up unlock if readings overlap between intended near and far positions or unintended actions occur.
